theorem: For a finite-dimensional unital dephasing semigroup generated by Hermitian interaction observables L_k, the Heisenberg fixed algebra is the joint commutant of {H,L_k}. Consequently an environment can select an algebra without naming that algebra as output, but the interaction observables themselves are typed input. For the strict-only choice L=A the fixed algebra has dimension 22, not the desired M12 direct-sum C algebra.
